ucs.title: [LLM] Cl0p (TA505 / GRACEFUL SPIDER) LEMURLOOT webshell drop on MOVEit Transfer (human2.aspx)
ucs.description: Hunts the canonical Cl0p MOVEit Transfer mass-exploitation signature (CVE-2023-34362, May 2023) — the IIS worker w3wp.exe writing the LEMURLOOT webshell `human2.aspx` (or variants) into the MOVEit Transfer wwwroot directory, and complementary IIS access logs showing requests to that URI. Mandiant / CISA attribute LEMURLOOT exclusively to Cl0p / TA505 and the artefact has not been observed outside this actor's MFT-extortion campaigns.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where Filesystem.process_name="w3wp.exe" AND (Filesystem.file_path="*\\MOVEit Transfer\\wwwroot\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\MOVEitTransfer\\wwwroot\\*") AND (Filesystem.file_name="human2.aspx" OR Filesystem.file_name="human.aspx" OR Filesystem.file_name="human2.aspx_") by host, Filesystem.action, Filesystem.file_path, Filesystem.file_name, Filesystem.file_hash, Filesystem.user | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "w3wp.exe"
| where FolderPath has_any (@"\MOVEit Transfer\wwwroot", @"\MOVEitTransfer\wwwroot")
| where FileName in~ ("human2.aspx", "human.aspx", "human2.aspx_")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, ActionType, FolderPath, FileName, SHA256,
          InitiatingProcessAccountName, InitiatingProcessAccountDomain,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessParentFileName, ReportId
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
W3CIISLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where csUriStem endswith "/human2.aspx" or csUriStem endswith "/human.aspx" or csUriStem endswith "/human2.aspx_"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, sSiteName, cIP, csMethod, csUriStem, csUriQuery, csUserAgent, scStatus, scBytes, csBytes
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Cl0p LEMURLOOT Webshell Drop on MOVEit Transfer (human2.aspx)
id: a5e1f3a0-4d2f-4f0c-9c52-cl0pmoveit0001
status: experimental
description: Detects creation of the LEMURLOOT webshell (human2.aspx) in the MOVEit Transfer wwwroot directory by the IIS worker process w3wp.exe. LEMURLOOT is the Cl0p / TA505 / GRACEFUL SPIDER signature webshell for the MOVEit zero-day mass exploitation campaign (CVE-2023-34362, May-Jun 2023) and has not been observed outside this actor's MFT extortion operations.
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/21
references:
  - https://www.mandiant.com/resources/blog/zero-day-moveit-data-theft
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa23-158a
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.t1190
  - attack.persistence
  - attack.t1505.003
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_proc:
    Image|endswith: '\w3wp.exe'
  selection_path:
    TargetFilename|contains:
      - '\MOVEit Transfer\wwwroot\'
      - '\MOVEitTransfer\wwwroot\'
  selection_name:
    TargetFilename|endswith:
      - '\human2.aspx'
      - '\human.aspx'
      - '\human2.aspx_'
  condition: all of selection_*
falsepositives:
  - Vendor-driven MOVEit application file deployment (verify against the change record and Progress / Ipswitch installer activity).
level: critical
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=FileWritten ContextImageFileName=/\\w3wp\.exe$/i TargetFileName=/\\MOVEit ?Transfer\\wwwroot\\(human2?(_v\d+)?\.aspx_?)$/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, TargetFileName, ContextImageFileName, UserName], function=count(as=writes))
| sort(field=writes, order=desc)
ucs.rationale: LEMURLOOT (human2.aspx) is uniquely Cl0p / TA505 tradecraft. Mandiant first attributed the artefact to UNC4857 / FIN11 / Cl0p in May 2023; CISA AA23-158A re-affirmed Cl0p attribution. The webshell's filename and drop path inside MOVEit Transfer's wwwroot are stable across every observed intrusion, and the writing process is always the MOVEit IIS application pool's w3wp.exe — there is no benign rea

ucs.title: [LLM] Cl0p Cleo MFT (CVE-2024-50623/55956) post-exploit — Cleo service spawning interactive shell from autorun XML
ucs.description: Hunts the December-2024 Cl0p mass-exploitation chain against Cleo Harmony / VLTrader / LexiCom managed-file-transfer servers, in which a malicious XML dropped into the Cleo `autorun/` directory causes the Cleo service (Java-backed) to spawn PowerShell / cmd / LOLBins that then stage the Malichus Java backdoor. The parent → child pairing of a Cleo product binary spawning an interactive shell is the unambiguous post-exploitation tell for this campaign.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.parent_process_path="*\\Cleo Harmony\\*" OR Processes.parent_process_path="*\\Cleo VLTrader\\*" OR Processes.parent_process_path="*\\Cleo LexiCom\\*" OR Processes.parent_process_path="*\\Cleo Communications\\*") AND Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","bitsadmin.exe","certutil.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","curl.exe","ftp.exe") by host, Processes.user, Processes.parent_process_name, Processes.parent_process_path, Processes.parent_process, Processes.process_name, Processes.process | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where InitiatingProcessFolderPath has_any (@"\Cleo Harmony\", @"\Cleo VLTrader\", @"\Cleo LexiCom\", @"\Cleo Communications\")
| where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","bitsadmin.exe","certutil.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","curl.exe","ftp.exe")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, AccountDomain,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentName  = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildImage  = FolderPath,
          ChildName   = FileName,
          ChildCmd    = ProcessCommandLine,
          SHA256, InitiatingProcessParentFileName, ReportId
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where ParentProcessName has_any (@"\Cleo Harmony\", @"\Cleo VLTrader\", @"\Cleo LexiCom\", @"\Cleo Communications\")
| where NewProcessName endswith "\\powershell.exe"
    or NewProcessName endswith "\\pwsh.exe"
    or NewProcessName endswith "\\cmd.exe"
    or NewProcessName endswith "\\mshta.exe"
    or NewProcessName endswith "\\wscript.exe"
    or NewProcessName endswith "\\cscript.exe"
    or NewProcessName endswith "\\bitsadmin.exe"
    or NewProcessName endswith "\\certutil.exe"
    or NewProcessName endswith "\\rundll32.exe"
    or NewProcessName endswith "\\regsvr32.exe"
    or NewProcessName endswith "\\curl.exe"
    or NewProcessName endswith "\\ftp.exe"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, SubjectDomainName,
          ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, TokenElevationType, LogonId
| order by TimeGenerated desc
